description: Weekly port congestion figures for one port from Portcast's public port page: median waiting time (days), average vessels waiting per day, congestion category and week-on-week change. Free public page data (not the paid API), and only for ports Portcast publishes; the slug is the port name in lowercase, e.g. ako or long-beach. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_port_call_schedule when you need Recorded daily port calls at one port by ship type; logistics_dry_port_inland_depot when you need Inland container depots and dry ports by country. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
